findings.title: async Express 4 handler without error handling
findings.description: The refund handler is async but not wrapped in asyncHandler and has no try/catch; if payments.refund or the DB calls reject, Express 4 never calls next(err), the promise rejection is unhandled and the request hangs (and a partial refund may go unrecorded). Wrap it in asyncHandler or catch and forward with next(err).
findings.suggestion: Wrap the handler in asyncHandler(...) like the GET route, or try/catch and call next(err).
